newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures end mixed, yen sags further.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures end mixed, yen sags further.

text.p: Oct 8 - IMM currency futures ended pit trading mixed. Yen sagged further late. But traders saw no big futures orders behind the move, which one chartist tied to technicals as Dec yen approached support near $0.009050 after negating Monday's bullish performance. Dec Can dollar hit support at $0.7404, but some look for upside move to resume soon. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
The floor broker said the December yen likely will slip further soon, based on those technicals.
"Had there been more time, it would have gone to 50 $0.009050)," he said. "The dollar/yen was impressively bid today."
Canadian dollar eased on profittaking as it consolidated its recent runup, and it nearly hit support at $0.7404.
"I think the overall feeling in the Canadian dollar is higher," said the broker. "This is a consolidation phase."
But he also said the contract might tread water heading into this week's Canadian economic data and events.

Minneapolis Fed's Gary Stern said he sees the current rate of economic expansion continuing. And New York Fed's William McDonough repeated his view that the Fed should target a range for core CPI to achieve price stability.
Currencies failed to react to the 0.4-percent drop in the Lynch, Jones & Ryan Inc Redbook retail sales index for the first five weeks of September versus August.

Dec yen fell $0.000028 to $0.009056, marks rose $0.0015 to $0.6574, Swiss added $0.0030 to $0.8057, pound down $0.0008 to $1.5618, Can dollar off $0.0006 to $0.7409, Aussie dollar rose $0.0029 to $0.7887, Mex peso fell $0.000350 to $0.127350. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
